policy: Only severe visible scan damage. Preserve historical fragments, minor holes, natural openings, and otherwise readable pieces with unscanned backs or undersides. The owner approved all four reviewed removals on 9 September 2026.

proposedRemovals.title: Parvati
proposedRemovals.reason: Large torn sheets of captured wall surround the head and torso, and the reverse contains a broad missing surface with stretched triangles.

proposedRemovals.title: Castlestrange Stone
proposedRemovals.reason: The top of the solid carved stone is almost entirely absent, leaving a large open shell with jagged scan edges.

proposedRemovals.title: Sitting Tattoo X
proposedRemovals.reason: A large irregular hole removes the crown of the head, with another missing patch on the upper body. These omissions interrupt the main figure; filling them would require reconstructing unrecorded surfaces.

proposedRemovals.title: Cupid and Psyche
proposedRemovals.reason: Broad open gaps remove the crowns and backs of both heads; torn capture surfaces surround the upper bodies. The museum's photograph shows complete heads.

repairs.title: Sutra Container
repairs.reason: Corrected a viewer bounds calculation for the articulated model and leveled its base. The intact container now fills the frame and stands upright.

repairs.title: The Kiss
repairs.reason: Local cleanup removes 304 isolated stray triangles above and beside the sculpture, preserving all retained surface attributes. Minor plinth capture remains.

meshRepair.method: Remove only isolated components in two visually confirmed regions above/beside the sculpture. No filling, smoothing, or alteration of retained vertex attributes.
